method: Two separate Chromium contexts, native BBS client and real WebSocket connections. Clients start actual solo/Pit saves first, then co-op. Passive client is naturally downed by live enemies; teammate moves, fights and channels a server-timed revive. Shared relays/key, two-player movement/combat/extraction, atomic host save, Node server restart and token resume preserve resources and completion. Manual fixed-step test clock accelerates wall time; no HP/ammo/position/objective/completion writes. Physical Quest pending.
